references.text: The continuation of the account about Jair, mentioning his thirty sons and their towns in Gilead
Jephthah was also from Gilead and judged Israel, in a similar manner to Jair
Tola arose to save Israel and judged for twenty-three years, using phrasing similar to that used for Jair
Other minor judges such as Ibzan, Elon, and Abdon who also judged Israel for a certain number of years
Jair, son of Manasseh, took villages in Gilead and called them Havvoth-Jair, possibly the same lineage
Jair, son of Manasseh, took the entire region of Argob and named the villages Havvoth-Jair
